nodes.description: SpaceportInfo struct holding owner, sale/base tokens, price, caps, liquidity percent, listing rate, start/end blocks and lock period.
SpaceportStatus struct tracking whitelist flag, LP generation flag, force fail, totals collected/sold/withdrawn, round1 length and buyer count.
mapping(address => BuyerInfo) storing per-user baseDeposited, tokensOwed and vesting accounting.
EnumerableSet.AddressSet of whitelisted participant addresses.
Address authorised to call init1/init2 to configure the spaceport.
ISpaceportLockForwarder used to check pair initialisation and lock liquidity.
ISpaceportSettings providing round length, fees and round1 token checks.
IWETH instance used to wrap ETH into ERC20 base liquidity.
SpaceportVesting struct with vestingCliff and vestingEnd timestamps.
SpaceportFeeInfo struct with PLFI base/token fees and fee recipient addresses.
Initialises spaceport owner, amount, price, caps, liquidity percent, listing rate, blocks and lock period; restricted to SPACEPORT_GENERATOR.
Initialises base/sale tokens, fees, fee addresses, round1 length and vesting configuration; restricted to SPACEPORT_GENERATOR.
View returning 0 queued, 1 active, 2 success or 3 failed based on blocks, caps and FORCE_FAILED.
Payable nonReentrant deposit crediting buyer.baseDeposited/tokensOwed and updating totals; refunds excess ETH.
NonReentrant pro-rata sale token withdrawal with vesting schedule based on block.timestamp.
NonReentrant refund of base tokens/ETH to buyers after failed spaceport.
onlySpaceportOwner withdrawal of remaining sale tokens on failure.
Anybody can force the spaceport to fail when the plasmaswap pair is already initialised.
PLFI_DEV_ADDRESS can force fail the spaceport.
NonReentrant final success step locking liquidity, paying fees, burning unsold tokens and forwarding remaining base tokens.
onlySpaceportOwner updates MAX_SPEND_PER_BUYER.
onlySpaceportOwner reschedules start/end blocks limited by getMaxSpaceportLength.
onlySpaceportOwner toggles WHITELIST_ONLY.
onlySpaceportOwner adds/removes addresses from the WHITELIST set.
Modifier requiring SPACEPORT_INFO.SPACEPORT_OWNER == msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for access checks, buyer lookup, refunds and token transfers.
Block timestamp used for vesting math and liquidity lock dates.
TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom of base token from msg.sender into the contract inside userDeposit.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value.sub(amount_in)) sending excess ETH back to the untrusted caller.
TransferHelper.safeTransfer of sale tokens to msg.sender in userWithdrawTokens.
TransferHelper.safeTransferBaseToken refunding ETH or base ERC20 to msg.sender.
External SPACEPORT_LOCK_FORWARDER.lockLiquidity call with approvals in addLiquidity.
WETH.deposit{value: baseLiquidity} external payable call in addLiquidity.
_amount parameter of userDeposit, the ERC20 deposit amount when the spaceport is not ETH based.
amount_in local: msg.value or _amount, clamped by per-buyer allowance and remaining hardcap.
tokensSold local computed as amount_in.mul(TOKEN_PRICE).div(10**B_TOKEN.decimals()).
tokensOwed local in userWithdrawTokens, pro-rata share passed to safeTransfer.
_spaceportOwner parameter of init1 stored as SPACEPORT_INFO.SPACEPORT_OWNER.
_maxSpend parameter of updateMaxSpendLimit written to MAX_SPEND_PER_BUYER.
buyer storage pointer to BUYERS[msg.sender] in userDeposit.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes BUYERS[msg.sender] and receives refunds and token transfers in userDeposit.
msg.sender selects the BuyerInfo record used for pro-rata token withdrawal.
msg.sender selects the BuyerInfo record used for base token refund.
onlySpaceportOwner compares SPACEPORT_INFO.SPACEPORT_OWNER with msg.sender.
ownerWithdrawTokens is gated by onlySpaceportOwner on msg.sender.
init1 requires msg.sender == SPACEPORT_GENERATOR before writing configuration.
init2 requires msg.sender == SPACEPORT_GENERATOR before writing tokens and fees.
forceFailByPlfi requires msg.sender == PLFI_DEV_ADDRESS.
Vesting cliff/end comparisons and vesting accrual depend on block.timestamp.
Unlock date passed to lockLiquidity and LP_GENERATION_COMPLETE_TIME derive from block.timestamp.
userDeposit reads and writes BuyerInfo entries in the BUYERS mapping.
userWithdrawTokens reads and updates BuyerInfo entries in the BUYERS mapping.
userWithdrawBaseTokens reads and zeroes buyer.baseDeposited in the BUYERS mapping.
spaceportStatus branches on STATUS.FORCE_FAILED and STATUS.TOTAL_BASE_COLLECTED.
spaceportStatus uses SPACEPORT_INFO caps, start and end blocks.
userDeposit requires spaceportStatus() == 1 (ACTIVE).
userWithdrawBaseTokens requires spaceportStatus() == 3 (FAILED).
addLiquidity requires spaceportStatus() == 2 (SUCCESS).
ownerWithdrawTokens requires spaceportStatus() == 3 (FAILED).
_amount is assigned to amount_in when the spaceport does not raise ETH.
amount_in.mul(TOKEN_PRICE).div(10**B_TOKEN.decimals()) computes tokensSold.
amount_in is the value passed to TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom for ERC20 deposits.
userDeposit sends excess ETH to msg.sender via transfer, an external value call.
userDeposit performs an external safeTransferFrom call on the base token.
userWithdrawTokens performs an external safeTransfer of sale tokens to msg.sender.
userWithdrawBaseTokens performs an external call transferring ETH/native balance to msg.sender.
addLiquidity approves and calls the external SPACEPORT_LOCK_FORWARDER.lockLiquidity.
addLiquidity forwards ETH to the external WETH contract via deposit.
tokensSold is added into buyer.tokensOwed and STATUS.TOTAL_TOKENS_SOLD.
tokensOwed local is the amount handed to the external safeTransfer call.
_spaceportOwner parameter is stored as SPACEPORT_INFO.SPACEPORT_OWNER in init1.
_maxSpend parameter is written to SPACEPORT_INFO.MAX_SPEND_PER_BUYER.
buyer storage pointer references BUYERS[msg.sender] inside userDeposit.
_amount is the caller-supplied deposit parameter consumed by userDeposit.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only exists as the caller-supplied deposit input of userDeposit and should be folded into that core function.
amount_in is a temporary clamped deposit value local to userDeposit with no independent semantics.
tokensSold is an intermediate arithmetic result inside userDeposit that is immediately credited to the buyer record.
tokensOwed is the computed payout amount that is directly consumed by the safeTransfer external call.
_spaceportOwner is only used to set configuration inside init1 and should be merged into it.
_maxSpend is a single-purpose setter parameter of updateMaxSpendLimit with no other use.
buyer is a storage pointer alias for BUYERS[msg.sender] used solely within userDeposit.
